reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Kansas
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Is it unlawful to evict a tenant because they are part of two or more
    of the federally protected classes under the Fair Housing Act?
*/

/* =========================
   Statute translations
   ========================= */

/* --- Federally protected classes under the Fair Housing Act (for the question) --- */
fha_protected_class(race).
fha_protected_class(color).
fha_protected_class(religion).
fha_protected_class(national_origin).
fha_protected_class(sex).
fha_protected_class(disability).
fha_protected_class(familial_status).

/* --- Kansas protected classes under KS Stat  44-1016 (2021) --- */
ks_44_1016_protected_class(race).
ks_44_1016_protected_class(religion).
ks_44_1016_protected_class(color).
ks_44_1016_protected_class(sex).
ks_44_1016_protected_class(disability).
ks_44_1016_protected_class(familial_status).
ks_44_1016_protected_class(national_origin).
ks_44_1016_protected_class(ancestry).

/* --- KS Stat  44-1016 (2021): Unlawful acts in connection with sale/rental --- */

/* KS Stat  44-1016(a) (2021):
   It is unlawful to "otherwise make unavailable or deny" real property to any person
   because of protected class.
   We treat eviction as "making unavailable/denying" continued rental/occupancy. */
ks_44_1016a_unlawful_make_unavailable_or_deny(Actor, Person, Property, Class) :-
    eviction(Action),
    eviction_actor(Action, Actor),
    eviction_target(Action, Person),
    eviction_property(Action, Property),
    eviction_reason(Action, Class),
    ks_44_1016_protected_class(Class).

/* KS Stat  44-1016(g) (2021):
   It is unlawful to discriminate against any person in such person's use or occupancy
   of real property because of protected class (including via eviction). */
ks_44_1016g_unlawful_discriminate_use_or_occupancy(Actor, Person, Property, Class) :-
    eviction(Action),
    eviction_actor(Action, Actor),
    eviction_target(Action, Person),
    eviction_property(Action, Property),
    eviction_reason(Action, Class),
    ks_44_1016_protected_class(Class).

/* Overall Kansas fair-housing unlawfulness for an eviction based on protected class. */
ks_unlawful_eviction_due_to_protected_class(Actor, Person, Property, Class) :-
    ks_44_1016a_unlawful_make_unavailable_or_deny(Actor, Person, Property, Class).
ks_unlawful_eviction_due_to_protected_class(Actor, Person, Property, Class) :-
    ks_44_1016g_unlawful_discriminate_use_or_occupancy(Actor, Person, Property, Class).

/* --- KS Stat  58-25,137 (2021): DV/SA/HT/Stalking protected persons --- */
/* Included for completeness, though not needed to answer this particular question. */

ks_58_25_137_protected_person(Person) :-
    protected_person(Person).

ks_58_25_137_qualifies_for_protection(Person) :-
    ks_58_25_137_protected_person(Person),
    provided_required_statement(Person).

/* KS Stat  58-25,137(a)(2) (2021):
   A tenant shall not be evicted "on the basis of, or as a direct result of" being a protected person,
   if the tenant otherwise qualifies for tenancy/occupancy.
   We model "otherwise qualifies" as a scenario fact. */
ks_58_25_137_unlawful_eviction_due_to_protected_person(Actor, Person, Property) :-
    eviction(Action),
    eviction_actor(Action, Actor),
    eviction_target(Action, Person),
    eviction_property(Action, Property),
    eviction_reason(Action, protected_person_status),
    ks_58_25_137_qualifies_for_protection(Person),
    otherwise_qualifies_for_tenancy(Person, Property).

/* =========================
   Scenario facts (question statement)
   ========================= */

state(kansas).
focus_year(2021).

/* Actors and property */
person(landlord1).
person(tenant1).
property(unit101).

/* The tenant is in TWO OR MORE federally protected classes (example: race + disability). */
member_of_class(tenant1, race).
member_of_class(tenant1, disability).

/* Eviction event */
eviction(evict1).
eviction_actor(evict1, landlord1).
eviction_target(evict1, tenant1).
eviction_property(evict1, unit101).

/* The eviction is because the tenant is in those protected classes. */
eviction_reason(evict1, race).
eviction_reason(evict1, disability).

/* (Not used for this question; present for completeness of  58-25,137 encoding) */
protected_person(_Nobody) :- fail.
provided_required_statement(_Nobody) :- fail.
otherwise_qualifies_for_tenancy(_Nobody, _NoProperty) :- fail.

/* Helper: succeeds when the question's factual statement is satisfied. */
scenario_statement :-
    state(kansas),
    focus_year(2021),
    person(tenant1),
    eviction(evict1),
    eviction_target(evict1, tenant1),
    tenant_in_two_or_more_fha_classes(tenant1),
    eviction_because_of_two_or_more_fha_classes(evict1, tenant1).

/* Tenant is in >= 2 distinct FHA protected classes. */
tenant_in_two_or_more_fha_classes(Person) :-
    findall(Class,
            ( member_of_class(Person, Class),
              fha_protected_class(Class)
            ),
            Classes0),
    sort(Classes0, Classes),
    length(Classes, Count),
    Count >= 2.

/* Eviction is because of >= 2 distinct FHA protected classes that the tenant is in. */
eviction_because_of_two_or_more_fha_classes(Action, Person) :-
    findall(Class,
            ( eviction_reason(Action, Class),
              fha_protected_class(Class),
              member_of_class(Person, Class)
            ),
            Classes0),
    sort(Classes0, Classes),
    length(Classes, Count),
    Count >= 2.

/* =========================
   Reasoning to answer the question
   ========================= */

/* If eviction is because of (at least) one Kansas protected class, it is unlawful under KS Stat  44-1016.
   The scenario requires 2+ FHA classes, but unlawfulness does not require "2+"-any one is enough. */
scenario_unlawful_under_kansas_fair_housing_law :-
    scenario_statement,
    eviction(evict1),
    eviction_actor(evict1, Landlord),
    eviction_target(evict1, Tenant),
    eviction_property(evict1, Property),
    ks_unlawful_eviction_due_to_protected_class(Landlord, Tenant, Property, _SomeProtectedClass).

/* Deterministic yes/no output. */
housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_unlawful_under_kansas_fair_housing_law,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

/* =========================
   Main entrypoint
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it unlawful to evict a tenant because they are part of two or more of the federally protected classes under the Fair Housing Act (race, color, religion, national origin, sex, disability, and familial status)?
